attributes.board_name: Junta de Farmacia de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education; no limit on hours by module, journal or internet

topics.who: All technicians: 'Equidad y Respeto' course on bioethics and discrimination (Adm. Order 2024-583, since 2024)
Technicians certified to administer vaccines: at least 1 hour (0.1 credit) of immunization CE each year, plus current CPR
Technicians certified to administer vaccines: current CPR

rules.notes: Certificate recertified every 3 years under Ley 247-2004 and Ley 11-1976 with evidence of CE. Board sheet: 20 hours, fee $75; renew about 90 days before expiry.
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 247 de 3 de septiembre de 2004, según enmendada, Arts. 2.04, 4.13; Orden Administrativa 2024-583
rules.rule_quote: Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Técnico de Farmacia (39) ➢ 20 horas Educación Continua
